spec = load_integrator_spec("02", "full")
control = summarize_integrator_run(
    integrator="velocity_verlet",
    time_step=0.2,
    num_steps=spec.experiment.num_steps,
    mass=spec.system.mass,
    omega=spec.system.omega,
    position0=spec.system.position,
    velocity0=spec.system.velocity,
)
print(f"max relative energy error={control.max_abs_relative_energy_error:.3e}")
print(f"forward/backward state error={control.reversibility_error:.3e}")
